## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, and passing
- [ ] No number is produced by an LLM (engine is the only source)

- [ ] New coefficients or datasets are recorded in `data/sources.yaml`
- [ ] Synthetic inputs are labelled "Illustrative"
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/DEPLOYMENT.md` if deployment changes, ADR if a decision changed)
- [ ] No secrets, no personal data, commit author is the intended identity
